pages.text: Swamp stealth cloth. $(thing)Each piece$(): mobs notice you 12.5% closer, and you deal 7.5% more damage to mobs that aren't targeting you. A full set halves how far mobs see you and adds 30% ambush damage. Bosses aren't fooled.$(br2)Armour like Netherite, toughness 2.5.
